title: Hikers Resting on Gorge Trail, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black-and-white vintage snapshot from the 1950s depicting two visitors perched on a stone wall overlooking a deep rocky gorge. A trail sign and stone staircase cut into the cliffside are visible among the dense forest foliage, characteristic of state park gorge trails such as Watkins Glen in upstate New York.
